αἰθέρα: αἰθήρ — upper air, bright sky; masc. acc. sg.
βιὸν: βιός — bow; masc. acc. sg. (poetic = τόξον; not βίος ’life’)
βροτέῃ: βρότειος, βρότεος — mortal, human; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic ἀνθρωπείᾳ): φωνῇ βροτέῃ ’with a human voice’
γλυκερός: γλυκερός — sweet, pleasant; masc. nom. sg., poetic (= Attic γλυκύς)
δενδρέων: δένδρεον — tree; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic δένδρων)
διαρρίπτασκεν: διαρρίπτω — hurl through, shoot through; impf. 3 sg., iterative -σκ-, unaugmented (= Attic διερρίπτει): ’used to shoot through’
διοϊστεύσῃ: διοϊστεύω — shoot an arrow through; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a general relative with κε
διοϊστεῦσαί: διοϊστεύω — shoot an arrow through; aor. inf. act.
δοιαὶ: δοιός — two, twofold; fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic δύο, διττοί)
δρυόχους: δρύοχος — prop of oak, ship-prop (traditional gloss; sense uncertain); masc. acc. pl.
δυσώνυμος: δυσώνυμος — of evil name, ill-omened; fem. nom. sg. (two-ending adj.)
εἰσορόωσα: εἰσοράω — look at, gaze upon; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰσορῶσα)
ζήθοιο: Ζῆθος — Zethus, father of Itylus in the nightingale story; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
θέντων: τίθημι — put, set; aor. imper. 3 pl. act.: ’let them put’
θερσόμενος: θέρομαι — warm oneself; fut. part. mid., masc. nom. sg., of purpose: ’to warm himself’
θνητοῖσιν: θνητός — mortal; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς), as a noun: ’mortals’
καθεζομένη: καθέζομαι — sit down, perch; pres. part. mid., fem. nom. sg.
καταθήσω: κατατίθημι — set down, lay down (as a prize); fut. 1 sg.
κατερήτυε: κατερητύω — hold back, restrain, check; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= κατηρήτυε)
κεράεσσι: κέρας — horn; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic κέρασι)
κεῖμαι: κεῖμαι — lie, lie down; pres. 1 sg. mid.
κοῦρον: κοῦρος — boy, son; masc. acc. sg., Ionic-epic (= Attic κόρος)
λέξεο: λέγω (II) — lay; mid. lie down; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic λέξαι)
λιποῦσαν: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. part. act., fem. acc. sg.
μένω: μένω — stay, remain; pres. subj. 1 sg., deliberative: ’am I to stay?’ (ἠὲ μένω … ἦ …)
μελάθρῳ: μέλαθρον — roof-beam, rafter; neut. dat. sg.
μελεδῶνες: μελεδών — care, anxious thought; fem. nom. pl.
μελιηδὴς: μελιηδής — honey-sweet, sweet as honey; masc. nom. sg.
μεμνήσεσθαι: μιμνήσκω — remind; perf. μέμνημαι remember; fut. perf. inf. mid., + gen.: ’to be going to remember’
νίψεν: νίζω — wash; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (= Attic ἔνιψε)
νευρήν: νευρή — bowstring; fem. acc. sg., Ionic-epic (= Attic νευρά)
νοσφισσαμένη: νοσφίζομαι — turn away from, abandon; aor. part. mid., fem. nom. sg.: ’having left’
ξεστῶν: ξεστός — polished, smoothed; neut. gen. pl.
οἰσομένη: φέρω — carry, bring; fut. part. mid., fem. nom. sg., of purpose: ’to bring’ (fut. οἴσω)
πανδαρέου: Πανδάρεος — Pandareus, father of Aedon the nightingale; masc. gen. sg.
παπτήνασα: παπταίνω — look around, peer about; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.
πελέκεας: πέλεκυς — axe; masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εας (= Attic πελέκεις)
πετάλοισι: πέταλον — leaf; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
πολυηχέα: πολυηχής — loud-sounding, resounding; fem. acc. sg.
πορὼν: πόρω — furnish, give; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’having given’
προὔχοντι: προέχω — jut out, project; pres. part. masc./neut. dat. sg., with crasis (προὔχοντι = προ-ἔχοντι)
πρότερ: πρότερος — earlier, former; neut. nom. pl., elided (πρότερ’ = πρότερα): ’the former things’
πύελον: πύελος — trough, tub; fem. acc. sg.
πύλαι: πύλη — gate; fem. nom. pl. (the plural is the usual form)
στορέσας: στόρνυμι — spread, strew; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.
τηλεκλειτοῖο: τηλεκλειτός — far-famed; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
τρωπῶσα: τρωπάω — turn, vary (frequentative of τρέπω); pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
χέει: χέω — pour, pour out; pres. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic χεῖ)
χλωρηῒς: χλωρηΐς — epithet of the nightingale, perhaps ’of the green leaves’ (sense uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
χυθείη: χέω — pour; aor. opt. pass. 3 sg.: ’might be poured, be shed’
χῆνές: χήν — goose; masc./fem. nom. pl. (accent from the enclitic μοι)
ἀέρθη: ἀείρω — lift, raise; aor. pass. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἤρθη): ’was lifted up’
ἀδινὸν: ἀδινός — thick, close-packed, thronging; neut. acc. sg., with κῆρ
ἀείδῃσιν: ἀείδω — sing; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic ending -σιν (= Attic ᾄδῃ), after ὡς δ’ ὅτε in a simile
ἀκράαντα: ἀκράαντος — unfulfilled, not brought to pass; neut. acc. pl., epic (= Attic ἄκραντος)
ἀκριτόμυθοι: ἀκριτόμυθος — of confused, indistinct speech; masc. nom. pl.
ἀμέτρητον: ἀμέτρητος — immeasurable, unbounded; neut. acc. sg.
ἀμήχανοι: ἀμήχανος — helpless, without resource; impossible to deal with; masc. nom. pl.
ἀμενηνῶν: ἀμενηνός — powerless, feeble, unsubstantial; masc. gen. pl.
ἀμφαφόωντας: ἀμφαφάω — feel all over, handle; pres. part. masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀμφαφῶντας)
ἀνάβαλλε: ἀναβάλλω — put off, delay; pres. imper. 2 sg.
ἀπερείσια: ἀπερείσιος — boundless, without limit; neut. acc. pl.
ἀποκλίναντ: ἀποκλίνω — turn aside; aor. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἀποκλίναντ’ = ἀποκλίναντα): ’having turned (it) aside’
ἀποσχήσει: ἀπέχω — hold away from; fut. 3 sg. (fut. ἀποσχήσω), + gen.: ’will keep from’
ἀρᾶται: ἀράομαι — pray, wish; pres. 3 sg. mid., + inf.: ’prays that’
ἀσχαλόων: ἀσχαλάω — be vexed, chafe; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀσχαλῶν), + gen. of cause
ἀφραδίας: ἀφραδίη — folly, thoughtlessness; fem. acc. pl., after δι’ (causal): δι’ ἀφραδίας ’through folly’
ἐΰξοον: εὔξοος — well-polished, smooth; neut. nom./acc. sg., epic ἐΰξοον
ἐκέχυντο: χέω — pour; plpf. pass. 3 pl.: ’had been poured out, lay strewn’
ἐλεφαίρονται: ἐλεφαίρομαι — cheat, deceive with empty hopes; pres. 3 pl. mid., epic (= Attic ἐξαπατῶσι)
ἐντανύσαι: ἐντανύω — stretch, string (a bow); aor. inf. act. (= Attic ἐντεῖναι)
ἐντανύσῃ: ἐντανύω — stretch, string (a bow); aor. subj. 3 sg., in a general relative with κε
ἐντεῦθεν: ἐντεῦθεν — from here, from this source; adv.
ἐρέθουσιν: ἐρέθω — vex, irritate, provoke; pres. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἐρεθίζουσι)
ἐρεπτομένους: ἐρέπτομαι — feed on, graze on; pres. part. mid., masc. acc. pl.
ἐφήσω: ἐφίημι — send upon, lay upon; fut. 1 sg.
ἐϋπλοκαμῖδες: ἐϋπλόκαμος (fem. ἐϋπλοκαμίς) — fair-tressed, with fine braids; fem. nom. pl.
ἑσποίμην: ἕπομαι — follow, go with; aor. opt. 1 sg. mid. (aor. stem ἑσπ-), potential with κεν: ’I would follow’
ἔαρος: ἔαρ — spring; neut. gen. sg. (= Attic ἦρος)
ἔκχυτο: ἐκχέω — pour out; aor. 3 sg. mid.-pass. (ἐκ + χύτο, unaugmented; = Attic ἐξεχύθη): ’was spilled’
ἔλθωσι: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. subj. 3 pl., in a general relative with κε
ἔτυμα: ἔτυμος — true, real; neut. nom./acc. pl., as a noun: ’true things’
ἕλκετο: ἕλκω — draw, drag; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic εἵλκετο): ’drew to himself’
ἕλῃσί: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic ending -σι (= Attic ἕλῃ), enclitic τε following
ἤλειψεν: ἀλείφω — anoint, rub with oil; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable
ἦξε: ἄγνυμι — break, shatter; aor. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἔαξε)
ἰαίνομαι: ἰαίνω — warm, cheer; pass. be cheered, delighted; pres. 1 sg. pass.
ἴτυλον: Ἴτυλος — Itylus, the child killed by his mother Aedon; masc. acc. sg.
ἵστασχ: ἵστημι — set up, make stand; impf. 3 sg., iterative -σκ-, unaugmented, elided (ἵστασχ’ = ἵστασκε; Attic ἵστη): ’used to set up’
ὀλοφυρομένην: ὀλοφύρομαι — lament, wail; pres. part. mid., fem. acc. sg.
ὀξεῖαι: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; fem. nom. pl.
ὀϊστόν: ὀϊστός — arrow; masc. acc. sg. (= Attic ὀιστός)
ὁρόωσα: ὁράω — see, look to; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὁρῶσα)
ὄναρ: ὄναρ — dream, vision seen in sleep (opposed to ὕπαρ); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ὑποκρίνασθαι: ὑποκρίνομαι — interpret (a dream), answer; aor. inf. mid.
ὑπόκριναι: ὑποκρίνομαι — interpret (a dream), answer; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid.
ὕπαρ: ὕπαρ — waking vision, reality (opposed to ὄναρ); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ῥακέεσσι: ῥάκος — rag, tatter; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ῥάκεσι)
ῥηΐτατ: ῥηΐδιος — easy; adv. superl., elided (ῥηΐτατ’ = ῥηΐτατα; Attic ῥᾷστα): ’most easily’

__broaden__.κτήσιος: Κτήσιος — Ctesius, a man’s name (Eumaeus’ father); masc. nom. sg. · also κτῆσις — possessions, property; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ιος (= Attic -εως), gen. of cause with ἀσχαλόων: ’vexed about the property’
__broaden__.γήμασθ: γαμέω — marry; aor. inf. mid., elided (γήμασθ’ = γήμασθαι), of a woman, used as an imperative: ’marry!’ · also aor. inf. mid., elided, after εἴα ’allowed’: ’(did not allow me) to marry’
__broaden__.κούρη: κούρη — girl, daughter; fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’daughter’ (θάρσει, Ἰκαρίου κούρη ’take heart, daughter of Icarius’)
__broaden__.ὀνείρῳ: ὄνειρος — dream; masc. dat. sg., with εἴκελον: ’like a dream’ · also masc. dat. sg., locative: ’in a dream’ (ἔν περ ὀνείρῳ ’even in a dream’)
__broaden__.ἕλοι: αἱρέω — take, seize, take hold of; aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’would take hold of’ (of longing, + gen.) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a general relative without κε: ’whomever sleep may seize’ (ὅν τινα … ἕλοι)
__broaden__.ἕπωμαι: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; pres. subj. 1 sg. mid. (after ὄφρα): ’that I may go with (you)’ · also pres. subj. 1 sg. mid., deliberative, in an either/or question: ’or am I to follow?’ (ἠὲ μένω … ἦ … ἕπωμαι)
__broaden__.δῖαν: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; fem. acc. sg. δῖαν, here extended to the sea (ἅλα δῖαν ’the heavenly brine’) rather than a hero · also of a place-name: Λακεδαίμονα δῖαν ’heavenly Lacedaemon’ · also of Dawn: Ἠῶ δῖαν ’heavenly Dawn’ · also of the upper air: αἰθέρα δῖαν ’the heavenly upper air’
__broaden__.δι: διά — through; prep. + acc., elided (δι’ = διά): ’through (the night)’ · also + gen.: ’through, through the midst of’ (δι’ αὐτῶν ’through the midst of them’) · also + acc., causal: ’through, by reason of’ (δι’ ἀφραδίας ’through folly’)
__broaden__.κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect (φίλον κῆρ ’in his own heart’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a verb: κῆρ ἤθελε ’my heart wished’ · also κήρ — death-fate, doom; fem. acc. sg., elided (κῆρ’ = κῆρα): ’death-fate’ (θάνατον καὶ κῆρ’ ’death and doom’) · also neut. acc. sg., after ἀμφί: ’around the heart’
__broaden__.γένοιτο: γίγνομαι — become, happen, turn out; aor. opt. 3 sg. (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish with μή: μὴ ... φίλον γένοιτο ’may it not prove pleasing’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish after αἲ γάρ: αἲ γὰρ τοῦτο γένοιτο ’would that this might happen’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish after εἰ γάρ: εἰ γὰρ … ἔρις γένοιτο ’if only a contest might arise’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a fear clause after μή: ’lest it come to be’ (μὴ … ἀμφαδὰ ἔργα γένοιτο ’lest the matter become public’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’it would be’
